intent: Freeze all contracts the Infrastructure adapter will honour BEFORE implementation begins, so any future CI failure is attributable to local Adapter (2A) or to database/composition wiring (2B), never to a contract drift.

decisions.D-0012-01: RepositoryFailure split: Serialization (retryable, wire/parse) vs CorruptedPersistenceData (non-retryable, semantic-at-rest).
decisions.D-0012-02: RepositoryFailure.Conflict.actualVersion remains OPTIONAL — adapters are not forced into a second read.
decisions.D-0012-03: Application public surface = logical Manifest with rule-based classifier, hash excludes generatedAt, 'other' gate distinguishes WARN vs FAIL by comparison to baseline.
decisions.D-0012-04: Bidirectional Adapter ↔ Application boundary (Infra→App AND App→Infra both forbidden).
decisions.D-0012-05: EventCodec lives in Infrastructure only; round-trip tests required in BOTH directions.
decisions.D-0012-06: Composition Root is the sole tri-layer importer (enforced in Wave 2B).
decisions.D-0012-07: Wave 2B integration suite registered with 3 mandatory scenarios: Concurrency, Re-hydration, RLS isolation.

newFitnessChecks.name: check-application-surface
newFitnessChecks.rule: Negative-only rules on src/application/finance barrels: no re-exports from __tests__/fakes/__mocks__, no Mapper/Codec/Util/Helpers/Internal files, no @/infrastructure/** or @/domain/** re-exports, no '_' or 'Internal' symbol names.

newFitnessChecks.name: check-adapter-error-boundary
newFitnessChecks.rule: Bidirectional. Infra→App forbidden (no app imports, no InvoiceApplicationError, no fromRepositoryFailure, no re-impl of isRetryable, no throw). App→Infra forbidden (no @/infrastructure/**, no @supabase/*, no pg/postgrest/kysely/drizzle, no SupabaseInvoiceRepository/EventCodec/PostgrestError mention).

nextWaves: UX-2B Wave 2A — SupabaseInvoiceRepository + EventCodec (local unit tests, no DB).
UX-2B Wave 2B — Migration, RLS, integration tests (3 scenarios), Composition Root, ADR-0012 → Accepted.
